decision_adr_21_7.RUBBER-VISC-03: v2 justified. Two measurement defects bias the exact solution as well: the estimator's window is not a whole number of periods and does not remove the sigma mean (-0.25 / -0.69 % in E' on exact sinusoids at 16 / 32 Hz), and the drive-end reaction is not the gauge stress (exact 1-D rod inertia at the real marker layers: -1.45 % at 32 Hz; the grip-1 minus grip-0 difference is -1.968 % observed vs -1.971 % predicted). Fixes: a whole-period mean-removed window starting after 6 tau_max, and de-embedding with the exact 1-D rod transfer, which uses only rho, L, the marker layers and w. The de-embedding is guarded by a grip-0 consistency validity bound of e1_rel / 5. Thresholds, the reference E*, the rate split and the time stamps are unchanged.
decision_adr_21_7.RUBBER-VISC-05: v2 justified. The declared left-point branch-work quadrature is not the conjugate of the discrete kinetic energy and is a first-order quadrature of the branch's own work; in diag_002 it misses D + Psi_v by exactly its book drift. Fix: visco_energy branch_work_kick_average_v2, which is bookkeeping only and opt-in, with off_v1 and branch_work_v1 unchanged. The cycle criteria use the whole-period window. Thresholds unchanged.
decision_adr_21_7.thresholds: None changed: tests/test_rubber_p2_3_protocols.py asserts that every v1 threshold of -03 and -05 is kept. deembed_consistency_rel 0.002 is added as a validity bound of the new method (stricter than any existing limit).

observations_reported_not_scored.E2_wrench_time_stamp: DIAGNOSTIC, found after the v2 run, not part of any criterion. The de-embedded E'' of visc_v2_001 is -0.435, -0.443, -0.467, -0.511, -0.625 and -0.867 % at 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 Hz, while E' is -0.40 to -0.41 % and the energy-based loss is -0.40 to -0.43 %. The control-step wrench average is the mean of the substep forces at t_{k-1} + j dt, j = 0..n-1, which centres it dt/2 before the declared stamp t_k - dtc/2. Re-stamped by dt/2, the same data give E'' -0.411, -0.411, -0.412, -0.395, -0.404 and -0.419 %, i.e. flat and equal to E' and the loss. The v1 stamp convention is kept in v2 because thresholds and stamps never move after a result, and E'' passes with that convention. A future protocol may adopt the corrected stamp.
observations_reported_not_scored.transient_in_v1_data_reanalysis: In the re-analysis of the v1 data (shorter runs, window starting at 5 / 4.4 tau_max), E'' at 16 / 32 Hz was -0.508 / -0.750 %. visc_v2_001 (window at 7.5 tau_max) gives -0.625 / -0.867 %. The difference, +0.12 %, is the start-up transient bias the exact linear response predicted for the early window (+0.13 %), and it is the reason v2 lengthened the 16 / 32 Hz runs.
observations_reported_not_scored.v1_accounting_on_v2_runs: The v1 left-point books recomputed on the v2 runs reproduce the v1 FAIL numbers exactly: cantilever 2.5758 / 1.0539 / 0.4736 %, 1 Hz cycle books +1.1664 %. The dynamics are byte-identical, so v2 changes only the measurement.
